summary: Assess whether a proposed outcome addresses a supported need and merits investment.

inputs.name: outcome-brief
inputs.description: The proposed problem, audience, outcome, and constraints.

inputs.name: project-context
inputs.description: Existing capabilities, operating limits, and relevant observations.

completion_checks: Evidence is separated from assumptions and advocacy.
Alternatives include an appropriate low-investment option.
The recommendation includes a falsifiable next decision.
failure_modes: No relevant observation can be obtained: inconclusive.
Required research or external contact is not authorized: blocked for that activity.
